tool.name: mumemto extract
tool.command:
ln -s '$m' input.mums && ln -s '$filelist' input.filelist &&
mumemto extract -m input.mums -f input.filelist -i $i -o 'output.fa'

param.name: filelist
param.label: File list
param.help: Text file with paths to the original FASTA files (one per line)

param.label: MUM index
param.help: Index of the MUM to extract (0-based). Default: 0 (first MUM).

tool.help:
**What it does**
Extracts the actual DNA sequence of a specific MUM from the original FASTA files. Requires the original file list used when running mumemto.
**Input**
- A `.mums` or `.bumbl` file from mumemto - The original file list (one FASTA path per line) - A MUM index to extract
**Output**
A FASTA file containing the extracted MUM sequence.
